content: S5 status, priority and group leave TaskItem, with the status vocabularies they keep alive: the status helpers in kcode-plan/src/lib.rs and canonical_todo_status plus its two wrappers in kcode-base/src/todo.rs. S2 took the TUI's (t31 took newly_ready_item_ids), so the field drop is what remains. Afterwards readiness is blocked_by empty and liveness comes from the member, not the item. Gate: the three fields gone and the vocabularies with them.

D2 the swarm/comm condense: the SwarmState handle pair is rebuilt as a literal at each request arm and threaded to ~40 functions; give the swarm state its one owner and delete the pair. This is the work that gates plans/server-shape.md H2. Gate: no SwarmState literal at a request arm.
G1 restore the two size ratchets in scripts/check_guardrails.sh and re-baseline both with --update; they are paused with the reason at the call site.

G2 the one live kcode run probe against its own socket, in a scratch repo, run by the user: the permission (a granted turn continues, a wake does not) and the poke's removal (no client continuation; every non-retryable error gets the short budget). It is the lane's landing proof, so it runs when the list is done, not per step.

note: Landed 2026-10-04: S4 (t17), G3 (t24), S2 (t15, four children t26-t29, -6,384 lines), S2's deadwood (t31, -5,116), the spinner dedup (c461d7bd, -47), and S3 (t16, children t33/t34, -498). S3 unblocked S5 (t18), which is now the next step. Also open: t32 (the roster's output tap and the inline spawn mode), t30 (the live TUI check, the user's), t20 (D2), t22 (G1), t23 (the socket probe, the user's), t25.

content: The live TUI smoke test for S2 and S3, deferred so it exercises both at once: build a fresh kcode, in a scratch repo add rows with the todo tool (two roots, one child naming a root as parent, one row blocked by another), confirm the pinned list shows id + words, the child indented, the blocked row marked and no card/page/pips/roster surface; run /auto (or spawn a worker) so a member takes a row and its glyph animates with @name, model and age; stop the holder mid-row and the row goes red; close a blocker and the mark clears. The numbered steps are in docs/plans/task-flow.md under The live check for S2 and S3. Gate: each observed screen matches, step by step.
